raw.rationale: Estramustine phosphate is a nitrogen mustard-estradiol conjugate that acts as a prodrug, releasing estramustine and estromustine to inhibit microtubules and DNA synthesis, with estrogen-receptor-mediated uptake contributing to prostate cancer activity; at 2.5 µM for 5 days it is broadly cytotoxic, and PRISM/CTRP data show little lineage-selective killing beyond modest breast/ovarian and possibly prostate (not listed) signals, so most lineages have low selective-kill probabilities near the base rate.
